title: Unit Event — Get Over It

meta.Outline: After their first solo show, Leo/need get advice about professionalism from anemone's Saku and STANDOUT's Iori. But something they say doesn't sit quite right with Saki...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
This is it. Leo/need's solo show...
I'm so glad that we kept supporting them this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I know they got pretty good recently, but they're putting on their own show now... They've really come a long way.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What do you think their set list is gonna be like? I hope they have a new song ready... I really can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The crowd seems really excited!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, but also, this place is totally packed!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There must be as many people as the time you girls played with anemone, no?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The fact that so you managed to fill the venue like this must mean that Leo/need is very popular now.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like a lot, but we made sure to invite as many of the people who've been supporting us as we could since it's our very first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That alone doesn't add up to this many people. I've gotta think your videos have also been playing a role.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they definitely have!
I noticed earlier that some people came here after seeing our videos.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really...?
They haven't been getting that many views. I was sort of under the impression that not many would have come for that reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm glad that they're showing interest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm really glad that we never gave up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're here to see us put on a good show, so let's give them one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't let them leave here with disappointed looks on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree...
But I'm sure we'll do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've done everything we could until now. Not just practice, but all the technical preparations too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We've put so much of what we have into this show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I also believe we'll be able to astound everyone that's here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Now we just gotta go out there and blow them away!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But also, I'm sooo happy!
I can't believe our hard work is finally paying off like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really think this...is gonna be our best show yet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure you girls will do splendidly.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Good luck and have fun.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's almost time. Wanna do our usual thing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I thought you'd never ask!
It's time for our star pieces of bravery to shine♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, why don't you lead us this time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Because we wouldn't have made it this far without you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like I just said, a ton of people have gathered to see our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For all those who helped make this show happen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For all those who pushed us in the right direction...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not to mention all those who came to see our other shows.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For all of them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want our first solo show to be like nothing else they've seen before. I absolutely don't want them to leave here after hearing our songs feeling disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is the culmination of all of Leo/need's hard work up to this point. And a chance for us to take a huge step forward towards achieving our goal.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We did so much until now just for this day.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But... It isn't just our hard work that made our solo show happen.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's also thanks to all these people who like our music.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Which is why I want them to have a really good time today and really enjoy the show...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, so... I'll be following your activities moving forward, and should an opportunity arise, I'd like the chance to work with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If our show goes well today, we might actually get to become professional musicians.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(It's been our goal...
It's been our dream... To go pro...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's do this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
We're Leo/need—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Th-They're going wild...
I've never heard a crowd roar like this before...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is so different from our other shows... Everyone's really here just to see us perform...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They want to hear us...our music...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(So this is what a solo show's like...
This is Leo/need's energy... Our energy...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming here today to see us perform in our very first solo show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot happened along the way before this show could actually happen...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're here today because all of you took a sincere interest in our music!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For all the support you've given us until now, we're going to put on a show today that you're never going to forget!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And to start things off...
We'll be playing something that we prepared just for this show. So, we hope you enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our newest song...!
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(...
That's seven songs...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm doing okay.
I'm tired...but I can still keep drumming.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I need to hang in there until the end...
So that everyone who came to see us goes home knowing that they just saw an unbelievable show!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This next song will be our last...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The others are so amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We didn't have anywhere near the stamina we needed at first. Playing five songs totally drained us...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi's voice sounds as clear as always. Shiho and Hona have been totally solid since our first song too.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Getting ready for our solo show was so hard, but they all did their best to get us here...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And some people out there feel genuinely encouraged by our songs...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I need to play with everything I've got... To give everyone the best show ever...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our last song!!!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last saw these girls play, but Ichika's power... Her band's performance... They've gotten so much better.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (And they're already putting on their own shows...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Their dream of going pro together might come true sooner than they realize.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: To be fair, that's when things get tricky.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (Leo/need's style isn't really my cup of tea.)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (But their performances stir something deep inside me... All these emotions are starting to well up inside me... I like this feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (I thought only a few others felt the same way, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (Who knew everyone had such good taste?)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (To be fair, I knew they were capable of this after our second battle.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Ichi sounds amazing...
Her voice is sending shivers down my spine... More than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I wanna ride this sound...
Then, each note we play will come together to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (...make everything super fun!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's sound changed...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is her usual sound with no frills attached... She's playing the way she does when we play our favorite songs together...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She doesn't care about playing well or how we'll be seen... Her sound just goes so well with this song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, this is what it's about.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The band still has a long way to go. We can practice all we want, but there are many more out there who are better than us.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But to us...
To Leo/need... It isn't about being the best...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's about having fun the way Saki is right now... Playing alongside each other and doing what we truly love...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yes... And this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is why I keep playing with them...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
...!
These girls...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
(Now I see.
Regardless of what my brain is thinking, they've grabbed hold of my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: (That must be why I like Leo/need's sound so much...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This song means everything to us, and I want them all to hear it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want it to reach them...
I want them to understand how we feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Nice...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
My instincts were right.
No, if anything...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I was more than right.
I didn't expect them to get this good after playing in that show with anemone.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'm glad that I spoke to them that time. If any of the other record companies had sent scouts to see today's show, well...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Things are definitely going to get busy...
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Nice work, girls!
That was such a super amazing show!!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, it really was an incredible performance. Though your battle the other day was also good...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You all seemed to have even more fun during this show. I got all excited just watching you girls.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Me too...
I felt this urge to play my guitar.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Your audience also seemed to enjoy themselves.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You touched all their hearts. You really put on a good show.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'm so glad you're all saying this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We had a lot of fun too.
Especially during our last song. I got so excited...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know what you mean. I always feel a little nervous during the last song, but I had so much fun this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I sort of didn't want it to end...
I wished that we could keep playing and stay with the crowd forever.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And you can't recreate that feeling even if you tried.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means our show was a huge success, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I didn't realize a solo show could be this much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Getting ready for it was really hard, but this means we can keep putting on more and more...
Hello, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Uh oh...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Rin, quick! We gotta hide!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see us today. So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What did you think...?
How was our solo show?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes, I came by to tell you all just that.
So, let me get straight to it...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It was a good show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This performance gave what you said the other day a lot of weight, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What I said...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. This was your first solo show, so it's only natural for there to be some rough edges. However...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I feel that you were able to put on the show I saw today because you were being yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That also goes for Ichika's lyrics and how Shiho plays during our shows. Our primary goal is to reach the hearts of as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That may seem unnecessary in terms of becoming professional musicians. But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I want us to stay true to our feelings. No matter what.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you felt that after seeing our show today, then we couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, um...
Will we be able to...you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: For now, I need to head back...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll be in touch. Hopefully, with some good news.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
W-Wait, so...
Does Mr. Shindo mean we...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe! Maybe! Just maybe! Right?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, calm down.
Though...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It did sound promising. I mean, the show we put on today was pretty convincing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I don't know what the future has in store for us, but I am getting a little excited about what he just said...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
I mean, if what he said is what I think he said, that means we...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We...
We really might get to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, girls. You free now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Iori... And Saku, hi!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting us today.
To be honest, I probably would've bought my own ticket if you hadn't...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
You put on a good show.
In particular, you all seemed to take a big step forward there at the end...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I was totally blown away by what happened there.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You played like you were having a lot of fun, and that really resonated with me. It felt like Leo/need's true sound...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much. That means a lot coming from you two...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on... Saku, Iori, did you two already know each other before this?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
No.
We met for the first time after your show.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I've been keeping an eye on anemone, so I decided to go over and talk to Kosaka.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Then I found out that they also knew about us, and our conversation just kept gaining momentum.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That led to us coming over to say congratulations to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Our music is helping tie people together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's such a nice thought...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Speaking of knowing people...
I've seen that guy we just passed a bunch of times hanging around live houses. Doesn't he work for a record company?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Oh, is that true?
Does the fact he was back here mean you guys know him?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Are we allowed to tell them...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't see a problem.
If anything, I'd like to get some advice from them about the future.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh? Are we talking about a touchy subject?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, not exactly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... The thing is, we...
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So, whether or not you got to sign with a label depended on this solo show...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: After seeing today's show, I wouldn't have been surprised at someone approaching you like that. But I honestly wasn't expecting it to happen this fast.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but nothing's actually been decided yet! We're still waiting to hear back from them...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Still, if that guy said that he'd have some good news, doesn't that only mean one thing?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, I've seen talks like these quickly go up in smoke before, so I guess it's best to not put all your eggs in this basket...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: At the same time, you've caught the attention of a record company. That means you have a real shot at going pro now or in the future.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-That'd be really nice...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Leo/need making their big debut.
Talk about an interesting turn of events.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: We'd sort of all be bursting onto the scene at the same time, no? Well, maybe not exactly all at once...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: And it would make us rivals, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Rivals...?
The same time...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, is anemone debuting too?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, did I forget to mention that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
I knew that a lot of companies had been approaching you and your band, but I thought you hadn't decided which label to sign with.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Yes, we were careful about that since we didn't want to sign with anyone that seemed shady.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Some even wanted to bill us just based on our looks and appearance, which is also not what we wanted.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But eventually, we found a label that we felt good about.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: It's not a big company, but they're going to let us pursue music the way we like.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
They seemed like the right choice...
So, last week, we signed with them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wow, really...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So, that means everyone here's going pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if we do end up signing with them, it's an indie label.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: These days, there's no real difference between the big labels and indie labels. They all perform the same functions, which means it's up to you to forge your own path.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's up to us...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's right. After you sign with a label, you'll be given access to more resources and opportunities.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: For example, putting a solo show together all on your own was pretty tough, right? I'm sure that included having to book a venue and selling tickets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that was tough...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We managed to find a way this time because others were willing to help us, but things got so hard when we had to do everything on our own...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: However, you can ask the label you sign with to take care of all that. That allows the musicians to focus on their music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: When it comes to shows, they'll know how to book good venues, throw in some cool effects and hire an experienced staff.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: They'll also know how to put music videos together that do your songs justice and find airtime with radio stations...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If things go really well, you'll get a chance to appear on TV.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On TV?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Basically, it's all with the purpose of getting you guys more exposure.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That way, more and more people will be exposed to your songs... “Happy” probably won't even begin to describe how you'll feel when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That would be so incredible!
Our songs being heard by that many people...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Our goal's still to move people's hearts through our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And how cool would it be for us to go on TV?! Our songs would reach the homes of so many people!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still, TV...
I'm getting nervous already...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's too soon for that, no?
Keep in mind that we haven't actually signed with anyone yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
B-But what if?!
I'm not sure I'll know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's not all sunshine and rainbows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Yes, it's true that you'll be given more exciting opportunities moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But like I said, how you take advantage of those opportunities is all up to you. Surviving as a band means battling with reality.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: With reality...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: She's right...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Until now, you've been able to pursue music the way you want, right? You've decided when to write new songs and put on shows.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But you can't do that as pros.
In the eyes of record companies, we're their business partners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're talking about having to work as stipulated in whatever agreements we sign?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: More to the point, you have to constantly think about becoming more profitable.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I get that it's not very fun to talk about this kind of stuff, but that's what it means to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We provide the label with music they can sell. In return, they'll do everything in their power to get people to buy it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Again, that could be through advertising, securing show venues or having songs used somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: In other words, how successful you are as professional artists depends on how much money you can bring in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And we won't be able to sign bands that we don't believe will become successful. After all, business is business.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What happens if we aren't profitable enough...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Will they terminate our contract...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: That's one possibility.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Actually, that might be one of the best outcomes for an artist who's struggling to bring in money...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I agree. Not finding success as an artist isn't just your problem.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: When a label signs a band, they believe, “They're gonna make it!” However, some don't despite having a ton of time and money invested into them.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: When that happens, they have to deal with the guilt they feel toward everyone who worked so hard to promote them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Right. If we do go pro but don't find success...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We'd end up causing a lot of people a lot of trouble, including Mr. Shindo. After convincing him that our music is worth it...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm not trying to sound like I know everything, but going pro means a whole slew of other people getting involved in your music.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You guys should keep that in mind moving forward since it's pretty common for bands to get into fights over that very issue.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Get into fights...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, I recently heard a story about that.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: There was this one band where the vocalist wanted to become popular by writing catchy songs, but the guitarist and bassist didn't care as much about that. They just wanted to have fun making music.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Apparently, that gap between them turned into a chasm, which ultimately led to them breaking up.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: They were pretty famous for getting along really well too.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, it happens more often than people realize.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, we almost suffered the same fate...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But it just comes down to how strong your shared desire to have your music heard is, no? Isn't that what it means to be a band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What it means to be a band...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with bandmates being close friends. But just being friends isn't what a band is about, right?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: A band's number one goal is to have your music heard by as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I also want as many people as possible to listen to Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We formed our band because we wanted our music to move the hearts of as many people as we could reach. That's why we want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I doubt we're going to forget that any time soon... So, let's keep doing what we can to achieve that goal and never let that feeling fade.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's right. We need to do more in terms of writing songs and lyrics that really resonate with people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Right... I've been hoping to touch people's hearts through our music. That's what's motivated me all this time...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But... But why do I feel so...?)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: A band's number one goal is to have your music heard by as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If I had to say what's number one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does playing at bigger live houses mean being able to produce a better sound?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That'll depend on the equipment, but better quality stuff also makes it harder to cover up our mistakes. We'll need to play each note perfectly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll have to start practicing much more if we're going to play at those kinds of venues.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Is this the right way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Even if we do go pro, am I gonna be okay feeling the way I do...?)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad our solo show went well, but I'm also glad that we got to hear Iori and Saku's advice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too.
It really feels like we've taken a big step forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now we just have to wait for Mr. Shindo to contact us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When do you think that's going to be?
Based on his tone, I feel like it'll be pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki...?
You're being much quieter than usual. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, umm... During our conversation just now, I started feeling kinda scared...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Scared?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean... Well, it's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But remember what Saku said?
“A band's number one goal is to have your music heard by as many people as possible.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been writing songs with just that in mind and wished for that to come true during all our shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if I were asked if that were the number one goal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something that feels a lot more important comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think getting to play music with all of you matters more to me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you guys all felt the same as Saku, right? That our number one goal should be to have our music heard by a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I'm kinda worried about how I feel right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I started doubting my commitment when it comes to going pro, and it scared me a little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't tell...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
I mean, I have to think we all feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's right. Obviously, we all want to keep playing music together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I'm sure we're all scared in some way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, no matter how much advice we get, we have no idea what it'll be like after we debut. We'll be crossing each new bridge as we come to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saku may be right about having more people listen to our music as our number one goal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And prioritizing wanting to keep playing music together might be the wrong answer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Both are equally important to me personally, but I don't know what the right way to go about this is. I think we just have to figure things out as we go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I believe we'll be able to.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing we're all scared of different things, but we have no way of dealing with any of those fears right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, I'll always be willing to listen to what's bothering you, and I'll do what I can to help you all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But these fears...
We'll just have to keep dealing with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I believe that we'll figure out a way to overcome all that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too. I'm also worried...
But I guess we really won't know what to do until the time comes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wanting more people to listen to our music and wanting to keep playing music with all of you are also equally important to me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think both are important to all of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I think they're right.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (There's no point in worrying over something that we can't possibly find an answer to.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(And we're all scared in some way.
So...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much.
I feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll figure out a way to deal with these fears and find a way to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Move forward... And go pro!)
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew... I'm finally done delivering those worksheets!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Grr... It's supposed to be lunchtime. Don't the teachers realize that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me. It's been about a week since our solo show...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we still haven't heard back from Mr. Shindo. I was sure that he'd contact us soon afterwards...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wait... What if this means they're not gonna sign us...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(N-No, that won't happen...
Mr. Shindo's probably a very busy person. He probably just hasn't gotten around to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? A message?! Now?!
Oh, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<Saki, where are you?
We're gonna start eating without you.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. We're supposed to have lunch together today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've gotta go now!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting!
Sorry I'm late—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you see my message?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your message...?
You said you're gonna start eating without me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's not important.
I mean the one after that about Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo...?
Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, we just received word.
So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He wants to meet with us about making our debut!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did get a little worried there for a second, but actually hearing back... My jaw was on the floor!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This means we have a real chance at going pro, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's so nice to see someone finally recognizing our music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-We did it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's really happening! We're going pro!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We should reply as soon as we can.
As for when we're going to meet him...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm still really scared...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Even though I couldn't wait to hear back from Mr. Shindo... I should be happy that his company wants to sign us...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We even decided as a group that we're going to deal with our fears...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I believe that we'll figure out a way to overcome all that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do...?)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, nice work today.
See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're meeting about our deal this weekend...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Am I really gonna be okay...?
Will I stop feeling scared by then...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I mean, the others said they're scared too.
I was hoping that these feelings would go away after a while...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I guess that's just not gonna happen...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I'm really worried...
But I just have to be brave and move for—)

Hm...?
Ms. Tenma, is that you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
What a coincidence.
Are you on your way home from that rehearsal studio?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Mr. Shindo...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, we just finished practicing there. We also saw the message you sent us this afternoon...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The others couldn't believe that we're actually gonna get signed to a label! Everyone felt more motivated than usual during practice today!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh, is that so?
I'm glad you're all enthusiastic about our proposed deal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, we're very enthusiastic! I mean, it's been our dream to go pro together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The others said that they're looking forward to our meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, Ms. Tenma, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You said that “the others” are looking forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But how do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I'm really happy...!
Because we've all been pursuing the same dream...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For so...very long...we've wanted to become professional musicians... So, um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In order to get more and more people to listen to our music...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's not too late for you to be out yet, so how about I buy you a drink?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
But I'm a minor!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Hahaha. I didn't mean anything alcoholic.
Just a cup of tea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But...
I feel bad about you paying for me...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Don't worry, this one's on my company. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I may be able to help if there's something weighing on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Yeah, Mr. Shindo's probably met tons of people like me until now. He might be able to tell me what I should do in this situation...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But what if he thinks, “What a downer! Maybe we shouldn't sign her”...?!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait for me...!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You feel stronger about continuing to make music with your friends than you do about having your music heard by others...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And you're worried if it's okay to feel that way, and afraid about the prospect of signing with a label.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Geez, I didn't feel like I could hide anything from him and ended up telling him everything...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well, if I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I agree with Ms. Hinomori.
There's nothing wrong with wanting to stay together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But hearing that didn't really make you feel any better, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
I mean...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Would you mind if I told you a little story?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A story?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's about a band you'd find anywhere else that became the talk of the town for a while some time back...
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A band you'd find anywhere else...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They were a lot like your band, Ms. Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: A group of friends from school who got together and started playing music together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Just like Leo/need, they were discovered while they were still in school and made their debut... They even made quite a name for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
They definitely had luck on their side.
However...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In terms of skill, it was the bassist and frontman who did the heavy lifting.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Obviously, everyone around them understood that, but after they debuted and when it mattered most...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
They were headhunted...
Someone else had the idea of using the frontman and bassist to form a new band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It was a big talent agency that handled many top-level artists, too.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There was talk of a massive ad campaign for them, and a spot at a big summer music festival.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Looking back, it was an unbelievable offer. What's more, switching to that agency would mean...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: ...a chance to have their music heard by more people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But...
If they took that offer... The band they made with their friends...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They broke up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But...
If that were me...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The bassist felt the same way as you, Ms. Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They chose playing music together over having their music heard by more people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Bassist
rows.Line: Ugh... Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Bassist
rows.Line:
Just why?!
Our music was supposed to...

rows.Speaker: Frontman
rows.Line: I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The frontman cared more about having his music become more popular by jumping ship.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Naturally, the original band broke up.
After that...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
The frontman...
Actually, I don't know what became of him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, so...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In retrospect, I'm sure there were a number of factors, but...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: His music was recognized because of the band he was in, and leaving probably caused all that to change.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ultimately, that band lost everything.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why I... I understand...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Wanting to have your music heard by others...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: ...and wanting to keep playing music with the people you were lucky enough to meet.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Being a band isn't about choosing between those feelings...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's about never losing sight of either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Never losing sight of either...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In that respect, Ms. Tenma, you seem to be doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, I believe there's no need for you to feel scared. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Wanting to stay together and wanting to have your music heard by others...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Those feelings are tough to balance, but I believe that balance lies at the heart of Leo/need's music.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also, I decided to start these talks with you because I personally like your music.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll do just fine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (He's right...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We don't need to decide what our “number one goal” is because both of those things are equally important.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I mean, my feelings...
All of our feelings... They're a vital part of Leo/need's music...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Old men like me can't help but ramble on, but I hope you feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm okay with how I feel now.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Then, see you again this weekend.
I'll be looking forward to our meeting.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! So, they're really gonna sign you to a deal?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're meeting this weekend to discuss it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's amazing.
Your dream of going pro might actually come true.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, their solo show did go pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it did.
And it's wonderful to hear such good news.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for dropping by to tell us this, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You shouldn't be thanking us.
We really should be the ones thanking you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's also nearly the weekend, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! My heart won't stop pounding!
I'm already getting kinda nervous about going over to their office!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What should we wear?
Suits?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree that we need to show that we're serious, but suits might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may actually have the opposite effect.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Then, we'll be fine in our regular clothes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Saki, you seem a lot better now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You felt scared about what was gonna happen after we went pro, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you don't seem bothered by that at all now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It did bother me a little until just recently... But I feel all better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I figured out a way to deal with my fears like you said, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You already found your answer, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I did!
I mean, I can't straggle behind while the rest of you keep moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'm really excited about us going pro now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we'll probably get to do lots and lots more stuff like Iori and Saku said!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem confident, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. The look on your face right now tells me that Leo/need will be able to handle whatever comes its way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As for your solo show...
It was good, and I'm guessing everyone there was moved by your performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that happened because you were being yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Being ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, during the last song in particular, we sort of just let ourselves go while we played it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I remember noticing that Saki had switched up her sound.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when I realized how we didn't have to try so hard to sound good. We could just have fun, and that's what makes our music what it is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once I knew that, things felt so much simpler, and I just had fun singing and playing my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
To be honest, we probably weren't as good technically compared to when we played with anemone, but the crowd was really on our side this time around...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly...
Music isn't just about technical mastery.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The emotions I felt during that song...
You all looked like you were having so much fun while playing it. Again, it was a very moving performance...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It reminded me just how much I love Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, even after you take this next big step, I hope you girls never forget that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Keep up the good work.
We'll always be rooting for you, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This means more and more people might start listening to your music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so exciting...
A few days later
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much for inviting us here today. So, regarding our deal...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to act so formal. Let's keep things friendly since we're going to be working together from now on.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Together...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As for the details, we'll be going over each part of your contract one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is going to feel like a tough slug, so I hope you're all prepared.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, once we've gone over all that, you'll be given a chance to discuss it amongst yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also, because you're all minors, you'll need to go home and ask your parents or guardians to review it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They'll be more than welcome to contact me directly if they have any outstanding questions regarding this process.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Again, there's quite a lot to go over and it's going to take time to review it all...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But once you sign after confirming that everything is in order, you'll officially be signed to our label as artists.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, shall we begin by reviewing the stipulations laid out in this contract?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
First, I'll give each of you a copy of it.
Here it is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! This font's tiny!
Yeah, it's definitely gonna take a lot of time to go through all this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's full of really important stuff, right? I'll do my best to read as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: U-Um, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Haha. Like I said, feel free to relax.
It'll make my job easier as well.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: More to the point, if you do sign this contract, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll be your main point of contact, so again, let's keep things friendly between us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Once we sign this contract, we'll officially start working as artists for this label.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We'll have our deal...
Our dream... We'll finally be pros!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I get that a lot of things are gonna happen moving forward... Some fun and some not so fun...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But I'm not hesitating anymore.
And I don't feel scared now. I'm okay...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wanting our music to be heard and wanting to keep playing music with them... Both things matter to me... A lot.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll be fine as long as I don't forget that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, I'm gonna keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Leo/need's gonna keep trying...
To move people's hearts with the music we love!)
